notes: Phase 3E.2A: the hundreds-form expression for Section 323. As with D02, this is the DESIRED outcome -- do not expand production parsing merely to make this pass. 'hundred' is outside the approved SpokenNumberParser grammar (digit/tens words only), so this case is expected to surface a normalization gap, not a recognition gap.
